exact_statement: For every n>=1, every quadratic q:F_2^n->F_2, every linear address map M, and distinct u,v with Mu=Mv, the actual Boolean F=(-1)^q(1-2*1_{u,v})y_{Mx}, with independent distinct named data signs, has the signed coefficient and physical influence ledgers of DERIVATION.md section 1. The address-first, then nonzero-restricted-polar-row stopping tree has B_i<=4 Inf_i at every queried node, hence zero localized bad-boundary bill at K=4, retains exactly one weighted data influence, and proves H(F)<=(4+2/ln(2))(I(F)-1)<7(I(F)-1) when I(F)>1 (H=0 if I(F)=1). The specified four-control separator tree violates B_i<=2 Inf_i at one descendant: Inf_i=1/4, B_i=1+(5/8)log2(5)-(9/8)log2(3), C_i=1, node weight 1/2. Extension: all inherited conclusions remain valid. For every quadratic q, linear M and edit set E of at most six vertices in one M-fiber, F=(-1)^q(1-2*1_E)y_{Mx} has the signed amplitude, crossing-edge influence and one-label fiber entropy ledgers of PROOF.md section1. The address-first, then minimum-index nonzero-restricted-polar-row stopping tree has B_i<=4 Inf_i at every queried node and localized bad-boundary bill zero. All terminal phase entropy is paid at rate 4+log2(6), preserving exactly one weighted data influence; H(F)<=(4+2/ln2)(I(F)-1). The exact generic four-control critical and five-control two-edge certificates are in PROOF sections2,6. For q=x0*x1+x1*x2+x3*x4 and seven edits {x:x0=x1=1} minus (1,1,0,0,0), the minimum-index root pivot x0 has Inf=1/16, B=1-(45/64)log2(3)-(25/32)log2(5)+(39/64)log2(13)>4Inf and C=3/8. Its full stopping bill is 3/8. Querying x1 first gives zero bad bill, queried influence 7/8 and terminal phase influence 21/16, and retains H<=(4+2/ln2)(I-1). This last result is one fixed seven-edit fixture, not a universal seven-edit theorem. Further extension: For every quadratic q, linear M and E of at most seven vertices in one M-fiber, the adaptive physical policy of PROOF.md sections2-3 queries a >=3/16 polar row at five-control seven-edit nodes when available, otherwise stops at the exactly proved rank-two radical-coset-minus-one collapse. It has zero localized K4 bad-boundary bill, retains all phase terminals and exactly one weighted data influence, and proves H(F)<=(4+2/ln2)(I(F)-1). For E of at most eight vertices in one M-fiber, the same policy uses the even pivotal-edge parity certificate at five-control eight-edit nodes; its bad bill remains zero and complete terminal payment proves H(F)<=7(I(F)-1). The collapse is an equality in original physical coordinates to a signed character times a one-point defect, with character supported on zero polar rows. The previously named fixed-order seven-edit obstruction is preserved.
hypotheses: Uniform independent sign controls and data, entropy in bits; q degree at most two including arbitrary linear part.
Different address values have different independent physical data coordinates; repetitions of the same value share one physical coordinate.
The K=2 obstruction concerns the specified representation-pivot tree, not all possible adaptive stopping rules or the full FEI conjecture.
Extension admits empty through six-point edits in one address fiber, with arbitrary quadratic polar matrix and conditional linear part; no fair reference selector or paired graph required.
Local normalization for the two-edge certificate preserves only the selected-coordinate erasure and influence, not other physical influences or boundary charges.
The seven-edit order obstruction and adaptive repair concern only the named Boolean fixture and two named policies.
New universal seven/eight-edit conclusions use the adaptive policy and paid algebraic stopping terminals; they do not claim every polar pivot is good or cover arbitrary nine-edit nodes.

proof_dependencies.scope: Exact signed ledgers, generic critical certificates, sparse/dense terminal payment, complete JS proof; original source proofs reproduced.
